spans.s:
sphuraṇa
(‘throbbing [of limbs]’)
------------------------------------------
Prognostication by observing the throbbing of one’s limbs seems to be an ancient field of knowledge.
Apart from some of the पुराणस् like the Matsya (24
), some independent works like the Vasantarājaśakuna (by Vasantarāja who might have lived in circa A.

) also deal with this subject in great detail.
The limbs involved in throbbing may be any one from the head to the foot.
For men, all throbbings of limbs on the right side indicate auspicious results; and on the left, inauspicious ones. For women it is exactly the opposite.
A few of these (for men) may now mentioned here:
Limb Prognostication
Top of the head. Acquisition of land.
Forehead. Prosperity in the present position.
Region of the eye. Death.
Upper arm. Union with friends.
Hand. Wealth.
Back. Defeat.
Chest. Success.
Soles. Journey with gains.

Saṁnyāsins were prohibited from practising such arts to gain alms.
The results of inauspicious indications can be offset by giving gifts as prescribed in the śāstras (vide Matsya-purāṇa 241.14).
See also ŚĀNTIS.
